triggers.desc: A list of objects, one control per property of an item by default.
A list of primitives (or of formatted objects such as localized strings), the item itself is the control. Enum arrays with `uniqueItems` are a selection instead.

descriptionClass.desc: CSS classes of the description, which is rendered as markdown.

items.desc: UI schema of one item: `Control` scopes are relative to the item schema (`#/properties/x`, or `#` for the item itself). By default a `VerticalLayout` with one control per property, or the item control with `label: false`.

addLabel.desc: Label of the add button, translated with `t()`; defaults to the `add-item` i18n key.

ordering.desc: Show the move up / move down buttons.

confirmation.desc: Ask for confirmation before removing an item (`confirm-remove-item`, `cancel` and `remove` i18n keys).

….desc: Every other option is passed as a prop to the [QList](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/list-and-list-items#qlist-api): `bordered`, `separator`, `dense`, `padding`...

data.desc: An array. A new item gets the default value of the item schema. `minItems` / `maxItems` from the schema (or the filtrex `min` / `max` rules) disable the remove / add buttons; AJV also validates them. Read-only, the buttons are hidden. A hidden list (`rules.visible`) is emptied.
